name: marketplace-deployment
description: The AWS Marketplace Deployment Service supports the Quick Launch experience, which is a deployment option for software as a service (SaaS) products.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists all tags that have been added to a deployment parameter resource.

subcommands.name: put-deployment-parameter
subcommands.description: Creates or updates a deployment parameter and is targeted by catalog and agreementId.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes a tag or list of tags from a resource.
